scenes.narrativeBeat: গানের মূল প্রবাহ — দৃশ্য ও আবেগ

shots.subject: environment
shots.actionEn: A wide establishing shot of a serene riverbank at sunset. The setting sun casts a warm, orange glow across the water, which is calm and reflective. In the middle ground, a young musician sits on the grass, a guitar resting in his lap. The silhouette of distant trees frames the scene.

shots.subject: scene
shots.actionEn: A medium shot focusing on the musician. He is gently strumming the guitar, his expression peaceful and lost in the music. The warm sunset light illuminates his face and upper body. The calm water of the river is visible in the background slightly out of focus.

shots.subject: scene
shots.actionEn: A wide shot of the entire riverbank. The musician is now a smaller figure in the frame, emphasizing the vastness of the natural environment. He continues to play as the camera tilts upwards to reveal the evening sky. A flock of birds flies across the colorful sky, completing the tranquil scene.

visualStyle: warm, serene, golden hour lighting, soft focus, cinematic
